text:
Alex K: Heads-up — prepping QBR for Helio (renewal ~next month). Need a quick triage on token run-rate, recent spike, and budget alerts so we can propose remediation in the deck.
Priya R: +1. Can you paste the 90-day run-rate and last week's surge numbers? I flagged a weird spike on Apr 9 in our tracker.
Jin L: Pulled billing now. 90-day median ~1.2B tokens/mo, last 7-day avg ~1.8B. Spike correlates with an embedding batch that ran 4/9.
Alex K: Link to the CSV or drive folder? Also we need model breakdown (gpt-4o vs gpt-4o-mini vs embeddings) for per-token econ.
Jin L: Drive: https://redwood-drive/helio-billing/2026-04-burn.csv
Jin L: Quick model rates (hosted list): gpt-4o: 0.035 per 1k tokens, gpt-4o-mini: 0.012 per 1k, embeddings-v2: 0.008 per 1k. I'll attach calc snippet below.
Jin L: ```
scenario,model,tokens_per_month,unit_cost_per_1k,cost_per_month
base,gpt-4o-mini,800000000,0.012,9600
growth,gpt-4o,1200000000,0.035,42000
embeddings,embeddings-v2,400000000,0.008,3200
``` 
Beth G: From our traces most of the extra tokens are embeddings from a nightly enrichment job. Recommend: route that job to a Dedicated embeddings pool + enable batching/KV cache. Expect ~30-50% token reduction with batching.
Miguel S: I'll draft spend-forecast slides with three scenarios (base/growth/surge). Can someone confirm assumed per-token costs I should use? Jin?
Jin L: Use the numbers above for hosted. I'll model reserved pricing separately if we want a Dedicated line-item.
Alex K: Also want two budget alerts configured: 1) daily burn > 120% expected, 2) any sudden model variant shift (unbudgeted model spawn). Can ops create alerts and a runbook for oncall steps?
ops-bot: Alert created: helio-budget-daily (threshold 120% daily expected). Alert created: helio-unbudgeted-models (notify on model mismatch). Notified: Priya R, Alex K, Jin L. :white_check_mark:
Priya R: For the QBR, propose three remediation levers: 1) Cost guardrails (alerts + quotas), 2) Route heavy embedding pipelines to Dedicated + batching, 3) Offer a credits/top-up cadence to reduce renewal risk. I'll own the proposal bullets.
Beth G: I'll assemble a short dev runbook for batching + KV caching examples (include sample code and config). Also add a short note on expected latency tradeoffs.
Miguel S: Slide ETA: Tue EOD. Alex can you review technical accuracy Wed AM?
Alex K: Yup. Also capture customer feedback: they called out unpredictable latency under peak — mark that as a renewal risk and our mitigation (Dedicated + routing policy).
Jin L: One more: do we include reserved capacity discounts in the deck? It materially changes the math. I can model host vs reserved vs committed annual.
Priya R: Yes include both. Action list: Miguel (slides), Beth (runbook), Jin (cost tables & reserved modeling), Alex (deck review). Rehearsal Thu 10am. :thumbsup:
Alex K: Thanks all — I'll pull the final slide into the QBR deck and add the ask for a pilot Dedicated pool for embeddings.
Beth G: Noted. I'll include sample rollout steps for Canary + metrics to watch (tokens/day, p50/p95 latency, failed batches).
Miguel S: I'll attach the draft slides in this thread when ready. Thanks everyone.
